It’s right in front of Prosperous Fountain Restaurant.
Mai Chun from Yunli Medical Company helped him get the job.”
Ling Ran felt slightly surprised and nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 742: Bright
paragraphs: The day patient Liu Xiaoyun was discharged, the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery became rather lively.
He Yuanzheng and the interns all came to join the crowd—some doctors from other departments even came to see the commotion.
All eyes lay upon Liu Xiaoyun, much to her discomfort, but she still put on her shoes before she carefully stood up with her son’s help. Then, she took two steps and went down upon the wheelchair.
The thirteen-year-old teenager then walked to the back and pushed the wheelchair toward the exit.
A cacophony of cheers and applause started.
Liu Xiaoyun also could not hold her smile. Her face was slightly pale, and her lips were not red, but she still waved at everyone with bright eyes.
A week ago, Liu Xiaoyun was at death’s door. Now, she had alighted from the bed, stood up on her own, and was wheeling her way out. This recovery speed was not unheard of, but still impressive.

This was especially so for doctors from Yun Hua Hospital who rarely paid attention to Ling Ran. They had heard about how well the prognosis of the patients whom Ling Ran operated on were, but as to how good it was, they could only listen to the people parroting each other’s views about how good Ling Ran was.

Liu Xiaoyun, who was admitted to the hospital to receive treatment this time, was a single mother who brought up three children, had a lovely son who was pitied by the people, and had foreign doctors who were involved in her treatment and understood her condition, that was why Liu Xiaoyun had been receiving additional care and attention since the day she received surgery.

Therefore, everyone came to know of the fact that the medical case under Ling Ran was incredibly complicated, but the patient was able to leave the ICU in just two days, and discharged after a week. Judging by that time period alone, Liu Xiaoyun’s recovery was not very fast. For current hospitals, being able to go home in a week after a laparotomy was a norm, and it was normal for a patient to go home after receiving a surgery via laparoscope.

However, Liu Xiaoyun’s condition was very severe. She had a 3-inch tumor, something many considered huge. Moreover, it was a tumor in the liver. Laparotomy was very harmful to the patient. Forget everything else, being put under anesthesia for a few hours was already a challenge for the patient.
But Liu Xiaoyun had truly recovered. At least until now, she had been pulled from the gate of hell back to a safe zone.

“You will need to receive chemotherapy next. You need to persevere through it.” Ling Ran was not good at discussing the condition of cancer patients with the patients themselves, so he could only give her an earnest reminder at that moment.

Zuo Cidian quickly continued the topic. He first passed a stack of promotional booklets to Liu Xiaoyun’s son before he said, “You need to come to the hospital according to the doctor’s requirement, and this is the most basic thing. Chemotherapy is rather difficult to endure. You might have seen a lot from the television and internet. Actually, current chemotherapy technology is very advanced, and there are many new medicines available. Most importantly, you need to persevere. If you just go through half of the entire chemotherapy session, you might as well don’t receive it at all. The doctor from the Oncology Department should have told you before...”
Liu Xiaoyun listened and nodded, but she could not help but raise her head to place her attention on her son’s face.
Her thirteen-year-old teenager had a determined look on his face as he listened to the doctor like he was attending a class, and he obviously wanted to remember every detail.
Liu Xiaoyun secretly sighed, and she subconsciously touched her son’s head.
She then raised her head and thanked Ling Ran and the other doctors again.
The notification that he received a Sincere Gratitude Treasure Chest was heard right on time.
Together with it was the Peers’ Admiration Treasure Chests, and there were a total of four of them.

Since Peers’ Admiration was also a one-time reward, Ling Ran guessed that the doctors who gave this treasure chest were from other departments instead of the Emergency Department and the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery. After all, the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery had been impressed by Ling Ran countless times, so it was impossible for them to give away four of them in a go.

‘Keep the treasure chests first, I don’t want to open them now.’ Ling Ran had accumulated enough Energy Serums, and he was not lacking any skills right now, which was why he was not in a hurry to open the treasure chests. Perhaps he will accumulate them for a period of time for now and get a big number before he opened them at once, and he might be able to get something good.
The system put away the treasure chests without saying anything.
In the afternoon, Ling Ran did a ward round as usual.

Now, his hospital beds and extra beds surpassed two hundred. This number of hospital beds was more than the hospital beds in most of the departments in the hospital. Right now, Ling Ran was not the only one who used up the hospital beds when performing surgery, Lu Wenbin, Zhang Anmin, and Yu Yuan would also demand to have three to six beds every day.
If Ling Ran did not implement the long-term hospitalization system, he might not be able to use the extra beds.
The additional beds were basically additional spots gained from the expansion of the Emergency Medical Center.

When the Emergency Department was upgraded to the Emergency Medical Center, it did not only change their reputation, but also brought about many substantial benefits. For instance, Huo Congjun had a higher degree of freedom in the Emergency Medical Center, and he could get more personnel authorized, as well as get more corresponding funding.

Besides, the basic infrastructure of the Emergency Medical Center had been greatly developed. Before the reception hall, a small building was newly built for the use of the selection of patients, and they also built in a fever clinic to reduce the probability of nosocomial infection outbreaks. The newly renovated hospital ward which extended from the warehouse made the ward area bigger. The newly renovated Operating Theater 1 had also finally a demonstration room to call its own, and it was very suitable for the purpose of the doctors showing off.
Newly hired nurses and ambulance drivers also made the Emergency Medical Center of Yun Hua Hospital livelier.

When Ling Ran walked through the corridor, he could feel the attention from more people. He did not really show it, but he was not satisfied with the mess in the ward area. There were more patients coming from other places, so correspondingly, there were more family members who kept the patients accompanied here. If they had one hundred and fifty patients here, their family members coming in and out would double that. Together with the nurses and care workers, when a group of people rushed out to watch him, he would feel like he was stuck in traffic.
“Doctor Ling, come to us.” A young girl quickly waved her hand when she saw that Ling Ran wanted to leave.
“Doctor Ling, Doctor Ling, we—” Another girl did not want to lose. She took down the scarf from her neck and waved it as vigorously as she could.
“Doctor Ling...” More kerchiefs, handkerchiefs, and scarves were waved along the corridor.

Ling Ran firmly shook his head. He only came to take a look at the patients today, but he would not go check room by room. The long-term hospitalization system implemented by Ling Treatment Group caused many patients to be hospitalized for more than fifteen days. Since it was the Emergency Department, the medical insurance companies would not investigate them as strictly.

Under such procedures, Ling Ran also did not need to do a ward round for every patient each week. Normally, he just needed to check specific patients who had just received surgery, while the remaining patients would be passed to their doctors-in-charge.

Today, Ling Ran was not ready to break the rules either. He followed his plan of carrying out his ward round for the patients who received knee arthroscopy and Achilles tendon repair before he went back to the waiting room in the Operating Area. Then, he saw three chefs with long white hats on their heads busying themselves with work in the small canteen.
“Ling Ran!” Tian Qi showed a sweet smile and said, “My family farm has a few good cows, so my uncle deliberately sent steak over by air transport. He said that he wanted to let you try it.”
“Your uncle?” Ling Ran was surprised.

“Yes,” Tian Qi answered, then she said happily, “My uncle is in-charge of the agricultural business in South America, and he also has a shipping company under him. A few years ago, he participated in a bull riding competition and injured his knee. He has not recovered from the injury even after such a long time had passed, so he went to consult a local doctor there, and the doctor told him that there’s a Chinese doctor who performs knee arthroscopy very well!”
Tian Qi looked very proud, and she said, “My uncle wants to invite you for a surgery, but he’s afraid that you’re not willing to go, so he deliberately sent a cow and three chefs over by air.”
“The chefs came over by air too?”
“Yes.”
“Hmm... Where does he want to have the surgery?”
“Is Brazil okay? His condition is not suitable for a flight, but we can take my personal jet there, and maybe treat it as a working holiday.” Tian Qi was full of earnest hope.
Ling Ran thought for a while. “Alright, but I can’t go immediately.”
Tian Qi instantly brightened. “Of course, we have to get ready first.”

chapters.title: Chapter 743: Unique
paragraphs: It was four o’clock in the morning, and Yu Yuan was at the fountain. She had her hair pulled up in a ponytail while she sat by the fountain and fed the big white goose with her trembling hands. She fed while she grumbled weakly, “Fragrance Yard, you’re so blessed. Look at yourself, you don’t have to do anything, but you have food to eat when you’re just laying down. You can eat whatever you want, and you don’t have any superiors caring about you, and you don’t have a boss asking you to complete your workload...”
The big white goose took two bites and turned around lazily.

Yu Yuan insisted on turning the head of the big white goose around and said, “Fragrance Yard, you better behave well. When I feed you, you don’t want to eat. What’s wrong? Are you waiting for the kids to feed you with snacks? Snacks are bad for your body. Don’t you forget what the doctor said about your indigestion. If you don’t take a proper meal and only eat snacks, you’re going to end up being a roasted goose.”
The big white goose glanced at her again before it laboriously closed its eyes.
“No way, Fragrance Yard, are you looking down at me? I’m kind enough to feed you, but you don’t even look at me...” Yu Yuan was getting angrier as she spoke, and her voice started to tremble.
“This goose might just want to sleep.” A voice was heard traveling airily from the distance.
In the dark, a doctor who wore a dirty white coat walked out, and it was the chief resident from the General Surgery Department, Li Jiahuang.

Li Jiahuang was slightly skinny, and his face looked shriveled. He entered the hospital one year later than Yu Yuan, and he only became the chief resident this year. If he worked for another half a year, he would have the qualification to become an attending physician.

Compared to Yu Yuan, Li Jiahuang’s career was much smoother. Since the status and income of the General Surgery Department were a little higher than that of the Emergency Department, Li Jiahuang always felt superior in front of Yu Yuan. Aside from the Emergency Department, there were not many departments that the General Surgery Department could look down upon. Whether Li Jiahuang was willing or not, he could only go to Yu Yuan and show off.

Yu Yuan usually disliked Li Jiahuang, so at this time, she also did not give him a pleasant expression. She glanced at him in scorn. “Do you think that everyone is lazy like you? Hey, what are the yellow stains on your white coat?”
Li Jiahuang originally wanted to retort, but he thought of something and lowered his head. Then, he saw that the bottom part of his coat was full of yellow stains.
Li Jiahuang recalled for a few seconds before he showed a face of disgust. He took off the white coat immediately and shook his head while he said, “I’m not sure how I got these stains.”

“You cut someone’s intestines?” Yu Yuan took a look at the shape of the stains and mimicked an explosion with her hands. She shook her head and said, “It came at you in the form of projectiles, and it’s normal for it to splash everywhere. I saw a patient before this where his feces rushed out from the large intestines and splashed against the wall, and they were quite elastic. They eventually rebound and hit the doctor’s back...”

“Alright, I have to go back...” Li Jiahuang could not bear to listen to it anymore, so he turned around to leave before he said, “Don’t torture Fragrance Yard, the goose also needs to sleep. You’re feeding it a proper meal at four o’clock in the morning. Even a normal goose wouldn’t be able to take it. I’m telling you, it already loves you a lot by not biting you.”
“Bullsh*t.” Yu Yuan gave the big white goose a slap. “I need to go to work at four o’clock in the morning, and you just want to sleep but don’t want to eat ?”
The big white goose was sleeping soundly. It woke up to a slap, and when it wanted to open its mouth to bite whoever hit it, it saw Yu Yuan, so it could only feel wronged and lowered its tamed head.

Li Jiahuang looked resigned. “Fragrance Yard knows nothing. You have to go to work at four o’clock in the morning, but there’s nothing wrong with it sleeping at this time. Besides, is your Emergency Department this busy? Do you have to work at this hour?”
Yu Yuan sighed. “Our Doctor Ling wants to take a few days off, so now, we have to fill up the hospital beds...”

“Fill up...” Li Jiahuang said, “That would be a great deal of bonus... Nope, work is work, but he can’t just overwork everyone to death, right? Your treatment group has quite a number of doctors, why don’t you just make arrangements with them?”

“Why should I make adjustments?!” Yu Yuan became unhappy immediately. “I’m the chief resident, even if I’m exhausted to death, the junior resident doctors can only step over my body to perform surgery. They can only dream about jumping over me!”
Li Jiahuang stared at Yu Yuan and said, “The one who needs to step over dead bodies is you, right?”
After he finished speaking, Li Jiahuang took the yellowed white coat and hastily walked away.

Yu Yuan snorted, turned around, looked at the big white goose, and asked seriously, “Are you really not eating? It’s hard for me to come over at four o’clock and feed you. Fragrance Yard, do you want to reconsider?”
The big white goose lowered its head and closed its eyes again.
“Hmm... not even making any noise. Are you sick? I’ll measure your body temperature.” Yu Yuan took out a thermometer as she spoke.
When the big white goose heard the term ‘thermometer’, it woke up immediately. It expanded its wings and wanted to leave, but it was too late.
Yu Yuan caught the big white goose’s wing, hugged it, pulled it up, and its an*s was exposed. In the next second, a thermometer was inserted into it.
“Honk...”
The big white goose helplessly lowered its neck and gave up on resisting.
Li Jiahuang stood far away at the entrance of the corridor. He tiptoed to look over here, and he coincidentally saw this scene. Then, he immediately turned around and ran away.

The wards in Yun Hua Hospital’s Emergency Medical Center were full for the whole day, while all departments in the Changxi Province, including those in the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City and Second People’s Hospital of Wuxin City were also full for the entire day.
Ling Ran and Tian Qi boarded the private plane sent by her uncle from the Tian family, which was a brand new and elegant Gulfstream.
Ma Yanlin and Yu Yuan, together with the chefs owned by her uncle from the Tian family, boarded the second private plane which was parked behind him—a partially new and elegant Gulfstream.

The cabin was decorated luxuriously but in a simple fashion. However, the exhibition of different compositions and colorful artwork prevented them from being immersed in the mood a little. That was especially true for Ling Ran, who was sitting comfortably in his chair. What he saw was a picture with a combination of colors, so he found it rather awkward.
Tian Qi noticed Ling Ran’s expression, so she could not help but chuckle and said, “My uncle deliberately invited an expert to draw this, and there’s a story behind it.”
“A story?”
“Look at the middle of the cabin, do you see anything special?”

Therefore, Ling Ran turned around to take a look. He saw that the middle section of the cabin, which was covered by white leather, was also full of different colored blocks, and they were similarly annoying.

“That’s my cousin’s work, she simply drew it.” Tian Qi chuckled. “At that time, there was a celebration, so my little cousin took watercolor and painted everywhere. When we noticed what was going on, it became how it looks like now. My uncle originally wanted to clean it, but there’s an artist who said that my little cousin drew very artistically, so eventually, my uncle decided to keep it. To match the drawing, he looked for people to draw these paintings in the cabin. What do you think now? Is this quite interesting?”
“Hmm.” Ling Ran seriously nodded. He thought and said, “Your uncle is quite silly.”
Tian Qi agreed and said, “Our family said this too, but my uncle is very suitable for agriculture because he is very patient. What do you think?”
Ling Ran answered, “He should be really patient, otherwise, he would have waited for two years and suffered through a knee injury without receiving any surgery.”

It expanded its wings and wanted to leave, but it was too late.
Yu Yuan caught the big white goose’s wing, hugged it, pulled it up, and its an*s was exposed.
In the next second, a thermometer was inserted into it.
“Honk...”
The big white goose helplessly lowered its neck and gave up on resisting.
Li Jiahuang stood far away at the entrance of the corridor.
He tiptoed to look over here, and he coincidentally saw this scene.
Then, he immediately turned around and ran away.

The wards in Yun Hua Hospital’s Emergency Medical Center were full for the whole day, while all departments in the Changxi Province, including those in the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City and Second People’s Hospital of Wuxin City were also full for the entire day.
Ling Ran and Tian Qi boarded the private plane sent by her uncle from the Tian family, which was a brand new and elegant Gulfstream.
Ma Yanlin and Yu Yuan, together with the chefs owned by her uncle from the Tian family, boarded the second private plane which was parked behind him—a partially new and elegant Gulfstream.
The cabin was decorated luxuriously but in a simple fashion.
However, the exhibition of different compositions and colorful artwork prevented them from being immersed in the mood a little.
That was especially true for Ling Ran, who was sitting comfortably in his chair.
What he saw was a picture with a combination of colors, so he found it rather awkward.
Tian Qi noticed Ling Ran’s expression, so she could not help but chuckle and said, “My uncle deliberately invited an expert to draw this, and there’s a story behind it.”
“A story?”
“Look at the middle of the cabin, do you see anything special?”
Therefore, Ling Ran turned around to take a look.
He saw that the middle section of the cabin, which was covered by white leather, was also full of different colored blocks, and they were similarly annoying.
“That’s my cousin’s work, she simply drew it.” Tian Qi chuckled.
“At that time, there was a celebration, so my little cousin took watercolor and painted everywhere.
When we noticed what was going on, it became how it looks like now.
My uncle originally wanted to clean it, but there’s an artist who said that my little cousin drew very artistically, so eventually, my uncle decided to keep it.
To match the drawing, he looked for people to draw these paintings in the cabin.
What do you think now?
Is this quite interesting?”
“Hmm.” Ling Ran seriously nodded.
He thought and said, “Your uncle is quite silly.”
Tian Qi agreed and said, “Our family said this too, but my uncle is very suitable for agriculture because he is very patient.
What do you think?”
Ling Ran answered, “He should be really patient, otherwise, he would have waited for two years and suffered through a knee injury without receiving any surgery.”

chapters.title: Chapter 744: Amid All That
paragraphs: At Mato Grosso, the small private jet that Ling Ran and his entourage boarded landed on a farm.

The runway of the farm was simple and wide. While the plane was landing, they could see the vast fields and herds of cows that looked like stars in the sky from afar. In Asia, this was something that could only be seen in Central Asia. Huo Qubing once crossed the vast desert, arriving at and conquering the vast meadow. Ever since then, the word “vast” was only used to describe the Gobi Desert in China.
As for the New World, they only cared about there being a balance between the ratio of forests and meadows.

Tian Qi was wearing a pair of riding boots, a T-shirt and a military green windbreaker. She rushed down the private jet and took a deep breath. She then turned and smiled at Ling Ran in embarrassment. “If I didn’t rush down the plane, I’ll probably get airsick.”
Ling Ran looked at her face and applied the visual inspection parts of the physical examination. Once he determined her condition, he said, “I’ll help you.”
As he spoke, Ling Ran reached out for Tian Qi’s forehead and pressed her head a few times.
It only took a few seconds for Tian Qi to feel refreshed.
Tian Qi could not help but blush a little right after that. She said in a soft voice, “Thank you.”
Ling Ran merely nodded.

Tian Qi glanced at Ling Ran, and the sight of his face put her in a good mood. She started introducing the place to Ling Ran in a soft voice, “The farm we’re at right now belongs to my uncle, so it’s relatively small. It should be smaller than 50,000 acres. My uncle named his farm ‘Zheng’s Farm’ as his name is Tian Guozheng. Doesn’t it sound informal?”
As Ling Ran breathed in the foreign air and stepped on the soil beneath his feet, he could not help but smile. “This is my first time outside China.”
“Eh, it’s your first time? How do you feel about it, then?” For some reason, Tian Qi was curious.
Ling Ran took a deep breath and said, “I’m now sure that there are indeed countries on the other side of the earth, and that those countries are inhabited. This has made me believe in science more.”
Tian Qi was puzzled. “What?”
Ling Ran smiled. “It’s just like how even though doctors have access to MRI scans, they believe in the things they see after cutting open the patients more.”

No matter how defined these methods of indirect examination were, it did not change the fact that they were not as clear-cut as direct examinations. This was how the concept of a gold standard came about in the field of medicine.

To Ling Ran, traveling to a foreign country and seeing with his own eyes that there was life on the other side of earth meant that he had achieved the gold standard in his personal scientific experiment.

“Let’s wait for Doctor Yu and Doctor Ma at the gazebo over there. We can go and see my uncle when they’re here. My uncle has been really bothered by his knee pain. He’s not even willing to step out of the door anymore.” Tian Qi decided to stop racking her brains over what Ling Ran just said.
Ling Ran nodded. They then boarded an open-air jeep to a group of Chinese-style buildings at the edge of the small in-farm airport.

A traditional Chinese gazebo graced the area in front of the rows of buildings, and a tea table, as well as a few benches, were neatly placed in the gazebo. A young woman in traditional Chinese clothes stood in the gazebo and made tea gracefully.
The steam from the pot rose in the air, giving the visitors an illusion that they were in ancient China.
Soon, the second private jet landed.
Ma Yanlin and Yu Yuan rushed out of the private jet in a haste. Even though they took a private jet over, they were tired and could not wait to set their feet on solid ground.

Compared to the doctors, the chefs who were sent to Yun Hua and had just returned to Mato Grosso seemed tremendously relaxed. By the looks of it, they probably traveled back and forth between China and Mato Grosso all the time. As soon as they arrived at the gazebo, without waiting for anyone to bark orders at them, they headed to three separate directions. They then brought over a bunch of equipment from the courtyard behind the gazebo. Soon, they had set up a barbeque grill beside the gazebo.
This was when someone walked out of one of the rectangular buildings. He was holding a long cut of marbled beef.
“This is a cut of edged beef. I’ve cut off the outer layer as the meat inside tastes better. It’s more tender, too.” One of the chefs explained things to Ling Ran and his entourage.

“Isn’t this quite a waste?” Ma Yanlin clicked his tongue a few times. He plopped down beside Ling Ran and gobbled down a few mouthfuls of water. “By the way, Chef Zhu, aren’t you going to ask us if we’re in the mood for beef? After flying for a day and a night, my whole body is super heaty.”

Chef Zhu, who had been cooking in Yun Hua Hospital for a few days, knew Ma Yanlin quite well by now. He placed a few slices of beef that he had just cut on the grill and asked, “Are you in the mood for beef?”
Ma Yanlin thought about it for a few seconds. “Yes.”
Chef Zhu rolled his eyes. “I’ll make sure that you’ll be the last in line for the beef.”

Ma Yanlin immediately refuted. “You do know that we have to make the patients’ family members sign the informed consent form even though we’re well aware that the patients will be operated on, don’t you?”
Chef Zhu said, “I’ll let you sign the informed consent forms before I put you on the grill and barbeque you.”
Chef Zhu switched on the air blower, and the charcoal fire started raging. The slices of barbeque meat were bright red.
The atmosphere was lively, which was what usually happened when a group of humans gathered. The vast meadow no longer seemed empty and dreary.
The sky was pretty much similar to the sky in China, with rolling white clouds.
Another airplane suddenly appeared amid the sunlight.
“Why is there another plane?” Ma Yanlin who was staring at the slices of meat happened to notice that the plane had gone lower.
“It seems that it’s about to land at this airport?” Tian Qi skillfully stood on the bench. She placed a palm before her forehead to cover the sunlight so that she could take a better look.
As Tian Qi spoke, the plane had already landed slowly and aimed at the runway.
“There’s more people coming over?” Ma Yanlin asked the young woman who was making tea.
“I don’t know either.” The young woman smiled and said, “You can ask the person in charge about it.”

No one bothered to do this. A few minutes later, they saw a group of people heading toward them in two separate jeeps. Three of them were wearing large white coats, and a stethoscope was hanging from each of their necks.
“Did your uncle invite other doctors too?” Yu Yuan hopped down from the bench and looked at Tian Qi.
“I don’t know.” Tian Qi whipped out her phone and said to Ling Ran, “I have only heard that he did consult a local doctor...”
“It doesn’t matter.” Ling Ran’s reply was very straightforward.

Before he departed for Mato Grosso, he had already carried out more than one hundred surgeries. Aside from this, he also guided around thirty surgeries. He did not really care if he got to operate on Tian Guozheng.
*Creak...*
The two jeeps stopped in front of the gazebo.

“Tian Qi... Miss Tian, what a coincidence, you’re here too.” A young man with a slender but muscular figure who was wearing a tight hunting suit hopped down from the front passenger seat of the first jeep.
All the people on the two jeeps got off the vehicles when they saw that the young man had hopped off.

“Miss Tian, you see, I heard that Uncle Guo Zheng was injured, so I quickly invited a few doctors over to take a look at him. You know, my father isn’t healthy either, and I have to call doctors over to our home and stuff all the time...” The young man in the hunting suit looked worked up, and his voice was loud too. He walked over quickly and leaned against one of the pillars of the gazebo as he stood.
Tian Qi looked calm as she nodded and said, “My uncle got injured two years ago.”

“He only wanted conservative treatment before this, right? I heard that he had been feeling unwell lately and want to receive surgery, so I quickly invited some doctors over.” The young man in a hunting suit smiled as he said, “It’s destiny that we happened to meet today. You must give me a chance to buy you a meal or something.”
Tian Qi glanced at him and shook her head. “I don’t like people with round shoulders.”
The young man in a hunting suit froze. He tried very hard to stop himself from turning and looking at his own shoulders. He asked hesitantly, “Round... round shoulders?”
“Among other things,” Tian Qi answered.

The young man in a hunting suit who had just flown for over twenty hours had a little bit of a breakdown. “Miss Tian, in all honesty, don’t you think that I’m considered handsome among men? Even celebrities nowadays can’t be that handsome—”
“I don’t want the meat to be too cooked.” Ling Ran rose and took a stainless steel plate from a chef.
There was sunshine.
There were rolling white clouds in the sky.
There was a slight breeze.

chapters.title: Chapter 745: Gigantic Mansion
paragraphs: Tian Guozheng’s gigantic mansion was situated beside a lake. The gentle slopes of a mountain range sat a mile or two behind the mansion. Surrounded by water and the mountains, the mansion looked like a very comfortable place to stay in.

The mansion was pretty huge too. It comprised a main building as well as three small buildings and could house almost a hundred people. If the mansion was used to house a party, up to ten thousand guests could be invited.
After all, the mansion was surrounded by ranches, stables, breweries, and other facilities. Ten thousand people could easily fit into these buildings combined with the mansion itself.

Lu Junjie who was wearing a hunting suit only regained his senses after he got out of the Jeep. He said as he looked at Ling Ran with a hostile gaze, “Doctor Ling, since you’re here, do make sure to have fun. You probably never had a chance to visit this kind of farm when you’re in China, right?”
Ling Ran nodded and asked, “Do you own a farm like this one in China?”
Lu Junjie froze for a moment and said, “I can own one if I want to.”

“He’s bluffing,” Tian Qi said and waved at the butler who was walking toward them. “I want to sleep on the third floor. Do make sure to give the third son of the Lu family a room that is far away from mine.”
“Roger.” The butler was Chinese. Even though he was old, he seemed capable. He also had an amicable countenance. He immediately agreed to Tian Qi’s request.
Lu Junjie’s face immediately fell, but he had no way to refute. Just like what Tian Qi said, he was merely the third son of the Lu family.
“Where’s my uncle?” Tian Qi asked the butler.

“He’s waiting for you guys inside.” The butler smiled. “Mister Guo Zheng asked me to prepare a scrumptious banquet so that you guys can have a good time. All the beef is flown in from 250 miles away, and they taste amazing.”
Ling Ran waited for a pause in the butler’s speech and asked, “Does Mister Tian Guozheng plan to receive surgery at home? Does his home have all the necessary equipment?”

“There’s a hospital called Guozheng Charity Hospital in the town nearby, and it’s sponsored by Mister Guozheng. You can operate on him there. If there’s a need, you can also order new equipment.” The butler continued a little proudly, “Cuba Town did not even use to have a clinic. All the rich people there took helicopters to big cities to seek treatment, and it was hard for the locals to find medical help. Ever since Mister Guozheng pumped in money to establish this hospital, all the people residing within a radius of a few hundred miles of Cuba Town have easy access to medical services.”
“The people in Brazil are having such a hard time?” Ma Yanlin was incredibly shocked when he heard this.

The butler nodded with a smile and said, “Usually, there are only three hundred to four hundred people residing in Cuba Town. Only when there is a festival would the figure go up to two or three thousand people. It’s kind of like villages in China. Moreover, the houses here are far apart from each other, and everyone has a car. Before the establishment of Guozheng Charity Hospital, there was only a pharmacy in Cuba Town.”
“Things are a lot worse there compared to many of the villages in China,” Ma Yanlin commented and asked out of curiosity, “Is Guozheng Charity Hospital large?”

“It is! They have thirty medical staff members as well as two operating theaters now. The hospital is also equipped with state of the art facilities such as an MRI machine...” The butler sounded like he was counting his family heirlooms.

As Ma Yanlin listened to the butler, he suddenly felt like laughing. He could not but say to Yu Yuan, “Why does it sound like he’s talking about Bazhaixiang hospital branch. Of course, there will never be an MRI machine in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch. They can’t even afford a CT machine.”

Yu Yuan twisted her lips. “There’s only two or three doctors and an X-ray machine in Bazhaixiang hospital branch. And the most common surgery there are debridement and corn removal instead of appendectomy and cholecystectomy.”

“But they have two operating theaters too, right? I reckon that the Bazhaixiang hospital branch may have more patients compared to Guozheng Charity Hospital.” As Ma Yanlin looked around the grandiose mansion of the Tian family, he felt like comparing things.
Yu Yuan looked at Ma Yanlin with sympathy. “I guess this is what happens when you’ve spent most of your career working under Doctor Ling.”
Puzzled, Ma Yanlin lowered his head and looked at the top of Yu Yuan’s head. He asked, “What do you mean?”

“Do you think that it’s proper to judge a hospital based on the number of operating theaters and the number of patients it has?” Yu Yuan shook her head. “It’s impossible for village hospitals and town hospitals to keep their operating theaters going all day long. It would be considered an achievement for them to carry out two surgeries in the same operating theater within a day. It isn’t so easy to carry out consecutive surgeries in the same operating theater.”
“Doesn’t this mean that they’ll need a few more operating theaters?” Ma Yanlin asked.

“I was talking about hospitals like Bazhaixiang hospital branch instead of proper hospitals. Moreover, since Guozheng Charity Hospital has thirty medical staff members, they should be able to keep their two operating theaters going all day long.” Yu Yuan shook her head and warned Ma Yanlin, “Don’t cause Doctor Ling trouble. There are quite a lot of people who know Mandarin here, including the doctors.”
Ma Yanlin traced her gaze, and he made eye contact with the three doctors who came here with the man in the hunting suit.
Ma Yanlin straightened his body. Like a muscular man in a bathhouse staring down a couple of scrawny men, he stared fiercely at the doctors.
The three doctors, who were either chief physicians or associate chief physicians, were no match to Ma Yanlin.

“You guys can get some rest first. Mister Guozheng had arranged a welcome dinner and party for you guys at night. After tonight, you guys can perform a physical examination and draw up a treatment plan for Mister Guozheng...” The butler enunciated each word clearly. He knew that it was the right time to speak, as he did not want there to be an argument between Ma Yanlin and the three doctors.

The doctors who came here with the man in the hunting suit were unfazed. Even though they had to travel quite far for this freelance surgery, they were used to the tasks involved. They did not see the need to worry.
Ling Ran, though, furrowed his eyebrows a little. “I had a good rest on my way here.”
“You can head to the banquet hall first. We’ll arrange for a few servers to attend to you.” The butler smiled.
“Can’t I start treating Mister Tian Guozheng right away?” Ling Ran intended to save time.
“I’m sorry, you can’t.” The butler insisted.
Tian Qi immediately understood the meaning behind the butler’s words. She said with furrowed eyebrows, “Ling Ran can’t treat him right away? Does this mean that he called other doctors over too?”

The butler flashed a smile and said, “You have to put yourself in Mister Guozheng’s shoes too. He had been very hesitant about what to do about his knee injury. He only decided to receive surgery because the pain is no longer bearable. Hence, he would like to hear a few experts out. Mister Jin Chengzai who owns Jinyuan Property happened to hear about Mister Guozheng’s condition, and he had invited a doctor over too. Mister Guozheng wanted to say no, but Mister Jin Chengzai insisted. The doctor is already on his way here, and he will arrive tomorrow.”
“Patients have the right to choose the doctors they want.” Ling Ran, though, seemed pretty nonchalant about it.
He had been flying around Changxi Province and carrying out freelance surgeries for more than a year, and things did not always go his way. Not everyone believed in him and supported him.

Most of his patients’ family members did not know much about hepatectomy. It might even be the first time one of their family members was admitted into the hospital and required surgery. Moreover, freelance surgery was something that was relatively new. Hence, more often than not, patients’ family members would have their doubts when they see Ling Ran.

Ling Ran had always kept his cool when this happened. After all, patients or their family members made the decision to hire a freelance surgeon for a reason. Having some time and space was beneficial to them as it helped them to make the right choices.
And what was considered the right choices to patients were not always choices that made the most medical sense. Whenever this happened, doctors had no choice but to let them be.
“Come on, let’s go and have some beef.” Ling Ran was unperturbed as he waved and said.
When Tian Qi saw that what the butler had just said did not affect Ling Ran’s mood, she immediately became happy. She quickly followed Ling Ran to the banquet hall.
The Lu family’s third son, who was standing beside the butler, widened his eyes. He looked like he wanted to say something.
“Excuse me, Mister Round.” Ma Yanlin walked past Lu Junjie.

Lu Junjie froze for a moment. He only realized that Ma Yanlin was referring to the incident earlier when Tian Qi said that he had round shoulders. He became so furious that his whole body was trembling.
“You guys better do well!” Lu Junjie said through gritted teeth as he turned to look at the three doctors behind him.

The three doctors glanced at one another and quietly left. They only came over with Lu Junjie because the Lu family was rich and held a lot of power. Why would they engage in such an idiotic conversation with Lu Junjie?”
Even though the three of them had walked quite a distance away, their voices could still be heard from afar.
“He’s Ling Ran from Yun Hua Hospital.”
“Yeah, the doctor who operated on Liu Weichen.”
“I heard that he’s focusing on hepatectomy right now. Why is he here to perform a knee surgery?”
“Don’t you know how highly Academician Zhu thinks of him? He would be able to make a living out of performing knee surgeries if he wanted to.”
“We really got f*cked over this time.”
“It takes a fight for people to get to know each other well. We’ll know him better after we have a few drinks with him later.”

Ling Ran nodded and asked, “Do you own a farm like this one in China?”
Lu Junjie froze for a moment and said, “I can own one if I want to.”
“He’s bluffing,” Tian Qi said and waved at the butler who was walking toward them.
“I want to sleep on the third floor.
Do make sure to give the third son of the Lu family a room that is far away from mine.”
“Roger.” The butler was Chinese.
Even though he was old, he seemed capable.
He also had an amicable countenance.
He immediately agreed to Tian Qi’s request.
Lu Junjie’s face immediately fell, but he had no way to refute.
Just like what Tian Qi said, he was merely the third son of the Lu family.
“Where’s my uncle?” Tian Qi asked the butler.
“He’s waiting for you guys inside.” The butler smiled.
“Mister Guo Zheng asked me to prepare a scrumptious banquet so that you guys can have a good time.
All the beef is flown in from 250 miles away, and they taste amazing.”
Ling Ran waited for a pause in the butler’s speech and asked, “Does Mister Tian Guozheng plan to receive surgery at home?
Does his home have all the necessary equipment?”
“There’s a hospital called Guozheng Charity Hospital in the town nearby, and it’s sponsored by Mister Guozheng.
You can operate on him there.
If there’s a need, you can also order new equipment.” The butler continued a little proudly, “Cuba Town did not even use to have a clinic.
All the rich people there took helicopters to big cities to seek treatment, and it was hard for the locals to find medical help.
Ever since Mister Guozheng pumped in money to establish this hospital, all the people residing within a radius of a few hundred miles of Cuba Town have easy access to medical services.”
“The people in Brazil are having such a hard time?” Ma Yanlin was incredibly shocked when he heard this.
The butler nodded with a smile and said, “Usually, there are only three hundred to four hundred people residing in Cuba Town.
Only when there is a festival would the figure go up to two or three thousand people.
It’s kind of like villages in China.
Moreover, the houses here are far apart from each other, and everyone has a car.
Before the establishment of Guozheng Charity Hospital, there was only a pharmacy in Cuba Town.”
“Things are a lot worse there compared to many of the villages in China,” Ma Yanlin commented and asked out of curiosity, “Is Guozheng Charity Hospital large?”
“It is!
They have thirty medical staff members as well as two operating theaters now.
The hospital is also equipped with state of the art facilities such as an MRI machine...” The butler sounded like he was counting his family heirlooms.
As Ma Yanlin listened to the butler, he suddenly felt like laughing.
He could not but say to Yu Yuan, “Why does it sound like he’s talking about Bazhaixiang hospital branch.
Of course, there will never be an MRI machine in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch.
They can’t even afford a CT machine.”
Yu Yuan twisted her lips.
“There’s only two or three doctors and an X-ray machine in Bazhaixiang hospital branch.
And the most common surgery there are debridement and corn removal instead of appendectomy and cholecystectomy.”
“But they have two operating theaters too, right?

I reckon that the Bazhaixiang hospital branch may have more patients compared to Guozheng Charity Hospital.” As Ma Yanlin looked around the grandiose mansion of the Tian family, he felt like comparing things.
Yu Yuan looked at Ma Yanlin with sympathy.
“I guess this is what happens when you’ve spent most of your career working under Doctor Ling.”
Puzzled, Ma Yanlin lowered his head and looked at the top of Yu Yuan’s head.
He asked, “What do you mean?”
“Do you think that it’s proper to judge a hospital based on the number of operating theaters and the number of patients it has?” Yu Yuan shook her head.
“It’s impossible for village hospitals and town hospitals to keep their operating theaters going all day long.
It would be considered an achievement for them to carry out two surgeries in the same operating theater within a day.
It isn’t so easy to carry out consecutive surgeries in the same operating theater.”
“Doesn’t this mean that they’ll need a few more operating theaters?” Ma Yanlin asked.
“I was talking about hospitals like Bazhaixiang hospital branch instead of proper hospitals.

Moreover, since Guozheng Charity Hospital has thirty medical staff members, they should be able to keep their two operating theaters going all day long.” Yu Yuan shook her head and warned Ma Yanlin, “Don’t cause Doctor Ling trouble.
There are quite a lot of people who know Mandarin here, including the doctors.”
Ma Yanlin traced her gaze, and he made eye contact with the three doctors who came here with the man in the hunting suit.
Ma Yanlin straightened his body.
Like a muscular man in a bathhouse staring down a couple of scrawny men, he stared fiercely at the doctors.
The three doctors, who were either chief physicians or associate chief physicians, were no match to Ma Yanlin.
“You guys can get some rest first.
Mister Guozheng had arranged a welcome dinner and party for you guys at night.
After tonight, you guys can perform a physical examination and draw up a treatment plan for Mister Guozheng...” The butler enunciated each word clearly.
He knew that it was the right time to speak, as he did not want there to be an argument between Ma Yanlin and the three doctors.
The doctors who came here with the man in the hunting suit were unfazed.
Even though they had to travel quite far for this freelance surgery, they were used to the tasks involved.
They did not see the need to worry.
Ling Ran, though, furrowed his eyebrows a little.
“I had a good rest on my way here.”
“You can head to the banquet hall first.
We’ll arrange for a few servers to attend to you.” The butler smiled.
“Can’t I start treating Mister Tian Guozheng right away?” Ling Ran intended to save time.
“I’m sorry, you can’t.” The butler insisted.
Tian Qi immediately understood the meaning behind the butler’s words.
She said with furrowed eyebrows, “Ling Ran can’t treat him right away?
Does this mean that he called other doctors over too?”
The butler flashed a smile and said, “You have to put yourself in Mister Guozheng’s shoes too.
He had been very hesitant about what to do about his knee injury.
He only decided to receive surgery because the pain is no longer bearable.
Hence, he would like to hear a few experts out.
Mister Jin Chengzai who owns Jinyuan Property happened to hear about Mister Guozheng’s condition, and he had invited a doctor over too.
Mister Guozheng wanted to say no, but Mister Jin Chengzai insisted.
The doctor is already on his way here, and he will arrive tomorrow.”
“Patients have the right to choose the doctors they want.” Ling Ran, though, seemed pretty nonchalant about it.
He had been flying around Changxi Province and carrying out freelance surgeries for more than a year, and things did not always go his way.
Not everyone believed in him and supported him.
Most of his patients’ family members did not know much about hepatectomy.
It might even be the first time one of their family members was admitted into the hospital and required surgery.
Moreover, freelance surgery was something that was relatively new.
Hence, more often than not, patients’ family members would have their doubts when they see Ling Ran.
Ling Ran had always kept his cool when this happened.
After all, patients or their family members made the decision to hire a freelance surgeon for a reason.
Having some time and space was beneficial to them as it helped them to make the right choices.
And what was considered the right choices to patients were not always choices that made the most medical sense.
Whenever this happened, doctors had no choice but to let them be.
“Come on, let’s go and have some beef.” Ling Ran was unperturbed as he waved and said.
When Tian Qi saw that what the butler had just said did not affect Ling Ran’s mood, she immediately became happy.
She quickly followed Ling Ran to the banquet hall.
The Lu family’s third son, who was standing beside the butler, widened his eyes.
He looked like he wanted to say something.
“Excuse me, Mister Round.” Ma Yanlin walked past Lu Junjie.
Lu Junjie froze for a moment.
He only realized that Ma Yanlin was referring to the incident earlier when Tian Qi said that he had round shoulders.
He became so furious that his whole body was trembling.
“You guys better do well!” Lu Junjie said through gritted teeth as he turned to look at the three doctors behind him.
The three doctors glanced at one another and quietly left.
They only came over with Lu Junjie because the Lu family was rich and held a lot of power.
Why would they engage in such an idiotic conversation with Lu Junjie?”
Even though the three of them had walked quite a distance away, their voices could still be heard from afar.
“He’s Ling Ran from Yun Hua Hospital.”
“Yeah, the doctor who operated on Liu Weichen.”
“I heard that he’s focusing on hepatectomy right now.
Why is he here to perform a knee surgery?”
“Don’t you know how highly Academician Zhu thinks of him?
He would be able to make a living out of performing knee surgeries if he wanted to.”
“We really got f*cked over this time.”
“It takes a fight for people to get to know each other well.
We’ll know him better after we have a few drinks with him later.”

chapters.title: Chapter 746: Attach Bayonets
paragraphs: At seven o’clock in the morning, the long motorcade was driven through the main gate of Guozheng Charity Hospital.

This was similar to other buildings in Cuba Town. Guozheng Charity Hospital did not strive to be a skyscraper. Most of its buildings were single- or double-story buildings connected in a long strip, and buildings with three floors were considered the limit. If anyone looked from the sky, the entire Guozheng Charity Hospital would look like a huge Chinese character “正”, read as Zheng, positioned in the east of the town.
A hospital with such a huge surface area only had thirty medical staff and slightly more than one hundred patients. If this were to happen in China, it would be considered quite bleak.

However, the Brazilians were obviously used to this setting where there were only a few people in a huge land, and they would do things to remedy the situation. For instance, they emptied the ground floor of the hospital building and connected it to the first floor to make it a large lobby. After such a wasteful act, the surface area of the hospital was no longer considered as too much.

Besides, the side building was mainly used as the hall and lecture hall. The hall could accommodate about seven hundred to eight hundred people, and it was lent to the schools in Cuba Town for free during normal days. This gave a good impression to the local people, at the same time, it also made the hospital livelier.

When they arrived, they were just in time of some local high school students organizing an event. There were a few dozen students and family members around, along with seven to eight pets and two horses, and it was incredibly lively.

“I guess they have asked a Fengshui master to make a reading here.” Ma Yanlin commented in a low voice before he said, “I know that some places are worried about having too few people around, so they want to get more youngsters over to make it livelier.”
“Conspiracies.” Yu Yuan stood by Ma Yanlin. Through the window, she looked at the green bush below and felt good.
“I mean, it’s rare to see so many people play in the hospital,” Ma Yanlin said, “Besides, they even brought horses. They sure aren’t particular with the details.”
“The horses came for surgery.” A Chinese worker walked in and heard their conversation, so he spoke.
“What surgery?” Ma Yanlin became curious.
“Spaying.”
“Spraying?” Ma Yan repeated. He suddenly felt that something was wrong, and he sensed a chill at his groin, so he asked, “You mean castration, right?”
“Yes.” The Chinese worker nodded. Then he pointed at the dogs below and said, “The dogs are also here for castration.”
Ma Yanlin and Yu Yuan looked down at the direction where his finger pointed. They saw that the dogs were happily playing and running about, and they sank into deep puzzlement.
Perhaps, happiness was always short.
“Doctor Ma, Doctor Yu.” The butler walked over and said politely, “It’s consultation hour.”
Ma Yanlin and Yu Yuan became serious at once.
The consultation today was obviously different from the other days.

The most common type of consultation in their local hospitals were department consultations or inpatient consultation, and there were already set procedures. The department directors or associate chief physicians who had built their reputations could give suggestions and plans in their field of expertise, while other people just needed to cover up the deficiencies in the plan.
Usually, the department consultation or inpatient consultation rarely had hostile arguments.
For the doctors, they were already busy enough, so why should they argue with each other for plans that had already been fixed?

In fact, normal tertiary Grade A hospitals did not have the need to argue over plans, especially among the attending physicians and associate chief physicians. The reason for their arguments was just because they did not like each other, and it was rarely because of mere medical reasons. Surgeries in normal tertiary Grade A hospital were more akin to technical work, which was working according to the experts’ plans or guidelines. If the doctors could suggest their personal opinions, they could be said to be very great.

In basketball terms, the doctors in normal tertiary Grade A hospitals were like athletes who were still learning skills. Regardless of whether they were good or bad, it all relied on their performance in practicing the three-step layup, their accuracy of their three pointers at 45 degrees, and their level at post-ups. If they could occasionally give their personal opinion on a particular action, they would be considered great.

However, at such a level, they might not be able to form any arguments, because they were all learning and working in the same frame. Their performance would be considered good or bad entirely on whether they could perform the standard actions or not, and this step was quite hard to display during the process of consultation.
However, since they came to provide consultation in Brazil, their cooperation could not be compared to inpatient consultations, and it was probably more challenging than outpatient consultations.
After all, everyone had different frameworks, so their working ideals might clash with each other in terms of its essence.

For example, when a doctor like Ling Ran discussed a question with a doctor like Boyle, if neither party had absolute authority in the field, then the conflict would easily be visible. Different thinking modes would make it difficult for them to reach a compromise.
Ma Yanlin and Yu Yuan looked at each other, and both had the thought of fixing their bayonets to attack.
Yu Yuan said as if she was quite experienced, “We must go for the first round. We can’t let Doctor Ling go.”
Ma Yanlin nodded. “We’ll depend on you now.”

Yu Yuan said, “I will try to attack their theories, and you follow my stance. If you can’t do it, you can just wave the flag and shout. We’ll be fine as long as we show an imposing might. The last one who makes the judgment is probably that Tian Guozheng. He is not a professional, so he will probably think that the side who appears to be more imposing is better.”
Ma Yanlin said, “I agree.”
Yu Yuan sighed. “We should have let Doctor Zuo come. At least he is good at speaking.”

“Old Zuo can’t even differentiate ‘chuck’ and ‘f*ck’, his stomach is not good, and he can’t eat a lot of beef. So if he comes, it’ll be truly considered a waste.” As Ma Yanlin spoke, he felt diffident. Then, he spoke again, “I even searched for Jinyuan Property yesterday. It was also a large-sized company with a scale that is worth a few billion. The doctors they found should be a bunch of great people.”
“That’s why we should establish our might first.” Yu Yuan was as determined as a little leopard who was ready to grab a lion’s food.
Ma Yanlin seriously nodded. Based on his multiple outpatient experiences, he stood straight, puffed up his chest, and raised his head while he entered the meeting room with Yu Yuan.
Doctors wearing white coats already filled the space by the sides of the meeting room.
The main seat was still empty. By the sides were Lu Junjie and another young guy. When they saw Tian Qi entering the room, they immediately stood up.
“Miss Tian, please take your seat here.” Two of them said at the same time, and they looked at each other with sharp gazes.

“Department Director Li, it’s all on you.” Lu Junjie decided to stop all internal conflicts and cast his sharp gaze on Ling Ran, who had just entered the room and said, “Department Director Li is a famous Beijing orthopedics specialist...”
“I don’t deserve this title.” When the three doctors who sat by Lu Junjie saw Ling Ran enter the room, they also quickly stood up and looked very humble.
“We have watched Doctor Ling’s surgery before. Previously, Yunli Medical Company set up a video broadcasting system, right? We always watch Doctor Ling’s surgeries, and we have learned a lot.”
“Yes, that’s right.”
“Doctor Ling’s skills are impressive...”
Jin Daliang from Jinyuan Property, who sat at the right, laughed “What are you doing? Lu Junjie, are you here for a delivery?”
Lu Junjie was so angry that his face became red. “Department Director Li, what are you doing? You agreed with what we have said yesterday, right?”

“Medicine is not something that we need to argue about whether it is right or wrong.” Department Director Li smiled and said, “It’s very clear that Doctor Ling’s skills are very good, and he performs arthroscopies very well. When I looked at Mister Guozheng’s body and medical conditions, I think Doctor Ling is probably better as the chief surgeon.”

Department Director Li worked as the department director of the Orthopedics Department in Beijing, and he happily earned an income of a few hundred million a year. Now, he just had to work for a few years more, then he would break up with his current mistresses and bring his new mistresses to go travel around the world. So, why would he be willing to work against a future star like Ling Ran? He did not really care if Ling Ran was a future star or not, after all, he was already a top-class star that shone at a blinding degree now.
Naturally, Department Director Li also seriously treated Lu Junjie dismissively, and he did not want to have a falling-out with him.
Lu Junjie had no way to fly into a rage, and Jin Daliang laughed even louder by the side.
Then, Jin Daliang said loudly, “Miss Tian, let me introduce to you Doctor Brent Wallace from the United Kingdom, a world-renowned orthopedic specialist—”

Brent Wallace was a man with a big frame. He stood up and nodded without smiling. Then, he talked to Ling Ran through an interpreter, “Hi, Doctor Ling. We’ve shared the same views for a long time, and we finally have this chance to meet. I am really excited—”

His disciple Brandon lifted his phone high and took pictures of his teacher Wallace. Then, he also took pictures of Ling Ran and Tian Qi. As the best uploader among doctors, Brandon’s photography posture was great, to the point that his posture in photography was already the typical posture taken by professional photographers.
Ling Ran shook hands lightly with Wallace.

“Doctor Ling, I like the Zhu-Ling Achilles Repair Technique that you’ve performed previously very much. It has a very good design and displays strong surgical ability. It’s absolutely the top in the world.” Brent Wallace gave him a thumbs up and said, “This time, I wish I can watch your surgery in person...”
As Brent Wallace spoke, he let the interpreter translate his words sentence by sentence.
When the interpreter was halfway through the translation, Lu Junjie cackled loudly.

chapters.title: Chapter 747: Palpation
paragraphs: Tian Guozheng was pushed into a meeting room in his wheelchair.

As soon as he entered the door, Tian Guozheng put his hands together and apologized to both sides, “I’m really sorry. I’m talking with several local people about the zebu business. After the breakfast meeting, my stomach is full. They still won’t let me go, so I can’t excuse myself. Brazil is a good place to discuss everything except cattle breeds. That one’s a problem...”
His show of weakness and his sincerity made everyone let his tardiness slide with a smile.

“I’ve invited several doctors this time, and I feel embarrassed about it.” Tian Guozheng looked at his butler, smiled, and talked about today’s most sensitive topic sincerely, “Ever since I came to Brazil, I’ve been injured multiple times, but not to the extent of having the need to go through surgery. This time, my health consultant told me that I have to do surgery, and I’m really scared...”
Everyone in the room showed cooperative smiles.

“As you can see, Cuba Town’s conditions are just average. It’s only suitable to treat some minor diseases, and my body is not suitable for long-distance travel. Therefore, I can only ask you to come here. After some thinking, I believe that there is strength in numbers. I hope you can give me more therapeutic plans as a reference,” said Tian Guozheng as he held up a teacup on the table.

The butler immediately came forward and began to distribute a stack of materials, and said, “This is Mister Guozheng’s recent test reports. Please don’t take it away. After reading it, please put it back in the bag...”
Ling Ran also got a kraft paper bag similar to an XL-sized archival bag.
When he took out the data inside, he saw various reports, especially imaging scans.
The first thing every doctor did was to look at the medical imaging scans. Ling Ran was no exception.
MRI scans.
CT scans.
X-ray scans.
Everyone looked at them one by one with a solemn expression.
“So... what do you think, everyone?” Tian Guozheng was a firm man. At this time, he was a little uncertain.

For a person, being able to use his knees or being able to walk were two different things. No matter how level-headed he was, he would feel uneasy when he faced a group of highly professional doctors.
“Doctor Ling, go on and voice your thoughts.” Brent Wallace gestured for Ling Ran to speak.

In the United Kingdom, Brent Wallace’s position in the field of Orthopedics was similar to Zhu Tongyi’s position in China. The two people’s age gap was not huge. Just like Zhu Tongyi in China, Brent Wallace had become a leading figure who was semi-retired from the frontline of the medical world.
Even if he were to perform surgeries, he would only do guided surgeries. Wallace’s original plan was to perform the surgeries with his apprentice. Since Ling Ran was there, he changed his plans.
Now that the British people took a step back, Department Director Li from China also could not be bothered to compete. He also did the same thing. “Doctor Ling, go on ahead.”
Once both parties modestly declined to speak, everyone’s gaze focused on Ling Ran.
Tian Guozheng had also been a vagabond for many years. At this moment, he instantly noticed that the incredibly handsome young doctor in front of him was in control of the situation.
Tian Guozheng could not help but look at his butler, who shook his head before he nodded.
Then, Tian Guozheng looked at Tian Qi, his niece, who looked back at him and was full of pride and confidence.

“I’ll perform a physical examination,” said Ling Ran as he took out an alcohol-based hand sanitizer. After wiping it all over his hands, he went to the front and performed palpation on Tian Guozheng before he made a few gestures in the air.
Ling Ran’s actions were simply pleasing-looking to others. It was as if he was greeting them and attracting their attention.
But for Ling Ran, he had already dissected Tian Guozheng’s knees.

Actually, since this was a surgery in the field of orthopedics he could get all the information he needed when he referred to the X-rays and MRI scans. However, Ling Ran did not mind spending a few seconds to verify the situation using the Virtual Human.
In Ling Ran’s point of view, the room was already flowing with blood. The cut femoral artery was like a slit up hose which could not spray out water but could only let it flow out.
At the same time, the uneven level of bone fragments also made the shape of the Virtual Human horrifying, as if its leg was cut in half.
“Doctor Ling?” Tian Guozheng focused on Ling Ran.

Ling Ran hummed before saying, “It’s a relatively simple meniscus injury, cruciate ligament injury, and osteochondral fracture. The recent pain you’re feeling should be mainly caused by cartilage fragments... ”
Tian Guozheng smiled. “You make it sound simple, but I don’t think it’s simple at all.”
“The surgery will take about thirty minutes or so,” Ling Ran said, “If we were to do it now, it should be over by lunch.”
“Haha, it’s that simple...?” Tian Guozheng obviously did not believe it. He smiled and looked at the other doctors.

Tian Guozheng was stunned for a moment. “The previous doctor did not describe it in such a simple fashion.”

For a moment, the room was in silence. Department Director Li coughed a couple of times and said, “Nothing is a small matter in terms of surgery. From the perspective of a patient, we have to say that surgery is neither a small matter nor simple. Of course, there are simple and complex distinctions when it comes to surgery techniques...”
Tian Guozheng understood it at once. People who were doctors also needed verbal skills to avoid shouldering responsibility, and that was why they made certain surgeries sound very difficult.
“So, should I have had my surgery earlier?” asked Tian Guozheng.

Department Director Li hesitated for a moment and said, “You have your own reasoning if you want to delay the surgery. Regardless of what the surgery is, there will always be risks. Statistics are for doctors. But for patients, if a risk occurs, they will have to suffer through it completely, isn’t that right?”
Tian Guozheng nodded and looked at Ling Ran.
Ling Ran said, “You should have had surgery earlier.”
Tian Guozheng was stunned again, and he smiled as he said to Tian Qi, “This is interesting.”
Tian Guozheng rarely praised people. He then turned around and was ready to receive the look of gratitude. But Ling Ran was expressionless.
“Interesting,” Tian Guozheng repeated with a smile, and he looked at Department Director Li and Wallace before he said, “How are you going to arrange the surgery?”
This time, it was Department Director Li’s turn to be stunned.

If this were an outpatient consultation, Department Director Li would have already classified Tian Guozheng as a difficult patient. In fact, Tian Guozheng now looked like a difficult patient. He not only tested doctors, but he also tried to participate in the doctor’s consultations and treatment process.
If he were any other patient, Department Director Li would have slapped him.

Unfortunately, Tian Guozheng had a special identity. So, even if he were a difficult patient, Department Director Li had to be patient as he said, “An arthroscopic surgery is generally relatively simple. We will do some physical examination for you and make some preoperative physical adjustments, mainly fluid transfusion and medication. If there is no problem, the fastest for you to go for surgery would be half a day, it will take two or three days if it’s slow. The wound for this surgery is very small, and it’s only on the knee, so you don’t have to worry...”

“I see... I’ve heard that although there are only small wounds in arthroscopic surgeries, there are still some downsides to it...” Tian Guozheng was hesitant. He had not had surgery for two years to treat the pain, and there was obviously a reason for it.

“Mister Tian, why don’t we perform a checkup for you first?” Department Director Li looked at Ling Ran and Wallace before he took the initiative to stand up. He was rather familiar with the situation in front of him.
Sure enough, Tian Guozheng nodded.
“If possible, we can find a few more patients with similar diseases, and we will have several similar surgeries along with yours,” Department Director Li added, and Tian Guozheng nodded again.

Tian Guozheng looked at Department Director Li, who knew what he wanted, and he almost wanted to ask him to be his chief surgeon. However, Tian Guozheng asked, “Why did you recommend Ling Ran to operate on me, Department Director Li?”

Department Director Li knew the meaning behind Tian Guozheng’s question. He glanced at Ling Ran and smiled in resignation. “Doctor Ling’s skill is better. In terms of arthroscopic surgery, Doctor Ling’s surgery records are better, and the patients’ recovery after surgeries are better.”
Department Director Li did not intend to compete with Ling Ran for the position of chief surgeon. He earnestly admitted this fact with the thought of being generous to the end.

Wallace, the British doctor, also supported and boasted about Ling Ran. Department Director Li did not recklessly fight for it. Even if he won the battle, he would just win over operating on a difficult patient. Department Director Li really did not want to fight.

Tian Guozheng listened to Department Director Li. The words he wanted say, which was, “You, come and operate on me.” immediately died in his mouth. Department Director Li spoke nicely, but as a patient who was frightened by the surgery, Tian Guozheng really could not give up on a doctor with better skills just for a doctor who could speak pleasantly.
